newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Swissair - no Sabena decision before end-96.
newsitem.headline: Swissair - no Sabena decision before end-96.

text.p: Swissair AG will not make a decision on whether to write-off its stake in airline Sabena before the end of this year, a spokesman told Reuters.
Gutknecht estimated the value of Swissair's 49.5 percent stake in Sabena at about 250 million Swiss francs.

The spokesman was responding to comments in Brussels by Sabena chief executive Paul Reutlinger, who said Swissair's board of directors had given Swissair management authority to write off the investment if deemed necessary.
"That does not mean we will do this. We are considering whether it would be appropriate or not," spokesman Peter Gutknecht said.
"A decision would be made at year's end at the earliest, when we prepare the 1996 balance," he added.
He said a write-off would only be considered "if no kind of solution is found with the labour unions" at Sabena.
